in reference assembly

  • CURIE: gmeow:inReferenceAssembly
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/inReferenceAssembly
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/places

The reference assembly (e.g. GRCh38) in which these sequence coordinates are expressed. Functional: a coordinate tuple is expressed in exactly one assembly; coordinates in another assembly are a different SequenceCoordinates instance (Principle 11).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:SequenceCoordinates -> gmeow:ReferenceFrame; functional Sub-property of: gmeow:hasReferenceFrame

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:inReferenceAssembly from gmeow:SequenceCoordinates to gmeow:ReferenceFrame when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:hasReferenceFrame, gmeow:SequenceCoordinates, gmeow:ReferenceFrame
